summary_zh: 未发现确定的坐标、单位、重复归一化或输出丢点接线错误；这不证明形状先验适合当前输入。
PVD仅生成XYZ，无RGB/图像条件；灰白材质是下游初始化与不可观测颜色的结果，不能称为PVD生成了灰白纹理。
原200点横跨123帧，仅7点位于车体中心以下；936/2048输出点低于全部199帧实测最低高度，属于无实测支持的形状先验。
仍需区分未知front符号、199帧多视点LiDAR与官方单视点合成深度分布、全框各向异性适配、以及Gaussian化造成的成像变化。

scope.note: Root coordinates any subsequent diagnostic inference; this review launches none.

components: BUILD colour fit / unseen columns retain prior

source_chain.minimal_geometry_rgb_valid_semantics: Stripped geometry artifact contains all-false placeholders; not the later reviewed observation-bank flags.
source_chain.comments: Generic prior contract advertises a sparse RGBA hint, but propose_pvd.py reads only XYZ and size; every confidence is one.

normalization.native_axis: x length/forward, y width/left, z height/up
normalization.pvd_axis: X width/right, Y height/up, Z length/back
normalization.front_sign_assumption: Native +X maps to PVD -Z, based on first fixed official car/train reference side view; author explicit front-sign documentation not established; no target complete geometry or sign sweep used
normalization.application_adaptation: Known target fullbox maps to mean complete TRAIN box; official class mean/std then applied. This is not an exact ShapeNet benchmark scene and no partial estimated dimensions or centering are used.

coordinate_checks.normalized_not_unit_cube: The official scalar-global-std normalization legitimately yields |coordinates|>1; a unit-cube expectation would be incorrect.
coordinate_checks.verdict: Mechanical affine/row/units wiring passes. Front semantic sign and suitability of whole-box-to-mean-box adaptation are not certified by invertibility.

checkpoint_and_training.category: car / ShapeNet synset02958343, based on official download provenance; no category label embedded in checkpoint
checkpoint_and_training.nc3_semantics: Three XYZ/epsilon output channels; not RGB and not three object categories
checkpoint_and_training.training_complete_source: PointFlow ShapeNetCore.v2.PC15k, 2458 car/train files, each15000 XYZ; previously2458 CRC verified
checkpoint_and_training.training_condition_source: GenRe single-view depth, cached600 points/view, first200 selected; random one of20 views used per training batch
checkpoint_and_training.official_normalizer_code_contract: train_completion.get_dataset first computes mean/std from all PointFlow car/train shapes, then explicitly passes those statistics to GenRe loader, which may filter missing/failed views. It does not recompute filtered-subset statistics.
checkpoint_and_training.stats_uncertainty: The actual checkpoint training run and exact filtered GenRe membership are not recovered. All2458 statistics could differ from descriptive statistics of the retained subset, but such a difference is NOT by itself a mismatch to the inspected official normalizer code. No evidence establishes a normalization bug.

original_environment_from_receipt.quality_status: Actual frozen partial-to-complete proposal; downstream legal-box/observed constraints and RGB fit still required

geometry_and_gaussianization.distance_caveat: Generated-to-observed distance is an evidence-distance diagnostic, not unobserved-surface error.
geometry_and_gaussianization.complete2048_policy: Current full_pvd keeps every raw point, including conditioning/out-of-box/invalid normals, with no axis conversion after actor_native_m decoding.
geometry_and_gaussianization.normal_policy: PCA16 inside min(.25,max(4*median nearest3 spacing,.03)); smallest eigenvector; outward sign n dot point >=0; invalid flags retained without replacement
geometry_and_gaussianization.interpretation: PCA normals, finite splat footprints, opaque peaks and thickness are downstream rendering conventions. They can fill gaps and change silhouette/depth/occlusion; they are not direct PVD predictions.
geometry_and_gaussianization.legacy_warning: The7503-row observed+filtered-prior surface and later1477-row residual layer are different assets; neither is the complete2048 PVD output.

current_M2_appearance_identifiability.meaning: A null column has no contribution to any fixed BUILD target pixel. Its colour is unidentifiable under this objective and remains the fixed prior; more steps cannot infer its true material.
current_M2_appearance_identifiability.distinction: No target contribution can mean hidden, off-target, culled, thresholded or occluded. A zero column alone does not prove every such point is physically unobserved.

remaining_adapter_questions.fact: Native +X maps to PVD -Z, based on first fixed official car/train reference side view; author explicit front-sign documentation not established; no target complete geometry or sign sweep used
remaining_adapter_questions.status: Unresolved semantic assumption; not a demonstrated coordinate bug; do not adopt a sign based on target visual preference.

remaining_adapter_questions.fact: Target [W,H,L] mapped to mean complete training bbox span, plus mean bbox-center and scalar normalization.
remaining_adapter_questions.status: Documented adaptation, not an exact benchmark convention or a learned per-target shape correspondence.

remaining_adapter_questions.fact: Original200 sampled from123 frames / fused multi-LiDAR OBB returns, versus clean synthetic single-view depth200; confidence all1 and ignored.
remaining_adapter_questions.status: Noise, rigid-box pose errors, viewpoint mixture, density bias and category-instance mismatch remain plausible; their causal contributions are unmeasured.

remaining_adapter_questions.fact: Only7 original conditioning points have z<0;936 completion points lie below every measured return.
remaining_adapter_questions.status: Unobserved support and material cannot be validated by the same sparse partial evidence.

remaining_adapter_questions.fact: Point-only PVD lacks normals, opacity, texture or surface connectivity; downstream PCA/footprints are additional assumptions.
remaining_adapter_questions.status: Point-cloud plausibility does not imply correct window/wheel geometry or render fidelity.

prespecified_short_inference_controls.execution_owner: Root; review only, no run launched here
prespecified_short_inference_controls.shared: Same official checkpointSHA,200 conditioning+1848 generated points,seed0,1000 linear beta steps .0001..02,eps,fixedsmall,clip_denoised=False,eval mode; original fullbox and train stats frozen
prespecified_short_inference_controls.R0: Original exact200 + original adapter; prefer saved initial1848 noise and matching saved RNG; compare RAW point arrays, fixed rows, normalized arrays and fileSHA separately. Publication NPZ adds an alias.
prespecified_short_inference_controls.Ryaw: Same original200 only change a proper yaw180 convention. H_training=diag(-1,1,-1); S_native=diag(-1,-1,1); inverse-normalized-to-native T_yaw=S_native4@T including translation; forward=inv(T_yaw). Check det+1, Y-up and fixed-point inverse error before inference. No visual-result front truth.
prespecified_short_inference_controls.Rvisible: Among BUILD frames with >=200 reviewed+depth-consistent samples select greatest count, tie smallest raw; current bank predicts raw106=255. Freeze200 unique cloud-row sample indices with rng0. Original adapter; no duplicate padding. This jointly changes purity, viewpoint and temporal support, so it cannot isolate denoising.
prespecified_short_inference_controls.exact_replay_caveat: Different GPU, CUDA, Torch, extension build, nondeterministic scatter/reductions can prevent bit equality. Record runtime/source hashes and initial noise/RNG; do not alter method to make only final pictures match.
prespecified_short_inference_controls.preregistration: Persist selected source rows, complete matrices+inverses, checkpoint/source/data hashes, initial noise/RNG policy and all evaluation denominators before any model result.
prespecified_short_inference_controls.evaluation: Report all arms as diagnostics. Fixed-source200 reconstruction and clean known-data tests are wiring checks; observed NN/projection checks use the same fixed observed denominator. Exclude conditioning rows from any claimed withheld-point metric. Unknown lower surfaces have no GT; no shape/colour claim from lower completeness or chosen sign.
prespecified_short_inference_controls.falsification: R0 disagreement isolates reproduction/runtime uncertainty before blaming adaptation. Ryaw differences only show orientation sensitivity. Rvisible differences show source-adapter sensitivity, not proof that one input is true or that unseen geometry is correct.
prespecified_short_inference_controls.optional_known_reference: A frozen official car reference with deterministic200 and known unconditioned complete points can test clean-data model/normalization/inverse behavior. Full-surface random200 is not the official single-view regime; a training reference tests deployment, not generalization. It bypasses the real-scene box adapter, which still needs its independent affine checks.
